name: InvoiceGuard
description: Checks a supplier's signed invoice before an agent pays it. It can stop a payment. It can't approve one.

skills.name: Check a signed invoice
skills.description: Signature, supplier, wallet, order, amount and duplicates. POST to /api/v1/check.

skills.name: Review a PDF invoice
skills.description: Hidden text and instructions aimed at software. POST to /api/review.

skills.name: Sample supplier agent
skills.description: Issues a signed sample invoice with a demo key. GET /api/supplier/invoice.
